title: One VPS Replaces Three Tools, Closes a Credits Hole | vitalii.no
description:
Text analysis and playlist generation depended on three outside services — Azure, Zvukogram and a separate Stanza/spaCy process — each a distinct point of failure and cost. Worse, credit deduction for using them ran in the browser, so a user who intercepted or replayed that client call could get output without ever being charged.

Built a single VPS-hosted runner that polls a new jobs queue table in Postgres, woken instantly by a database trigger and capped at three unfinished jobs per user. It now handles both analysis (word meaning, part of speech, translation, difficulty level) and playlist generation (text-to-speech with a local fallback) in one process. The client just queues a job and polls for the result — every credit deduction happens inside the runner itself, never in the browser — and the two old edge functions, 1455 and 341 lines long, were deleted outright.

Three external dependencies collapsed into one self-hosted process, roughly 1,800 lines of fragile edge-function code were deleted, and the client-side credit bypass no longer exists because charging happens entirely server-side.
